capabilities: Fetch exchange rates for crypto pairs through commands with a modal or default currencies
Render a crypto code block as a table of live prices and 24h change
Expose getPrice, getQuote and getQuotes for DataviewJS and other plugins
Fall back to Coinbase spot prices when CoinGecko is unavailable or rate limited
extras: The manifest description says it uses the Cryptonator API, but the README says prices come from CoinGecko with a Coinbase fallback. Installable via BRAT as a beta plugin; includes a donation link.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up current cryptocurrency prices or embed live price data in notes.

relations.evidence: The plugin exposes getPrice, getQuote and getQuotes on app.plugins.plugins["obsidian-crypto-lookup"].api
Prices come from the CoinGecko API (data provided by CoinGecko).
the plugin falls back to Coinbase spot prices, which include the price only

summary: Crypto price lookup that fetches exchange rates for cryptocurrency pairs via commands or a live-price code block and inserts them into notes.
